gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Tektur has outsized lowercase and curves that open up at every terminal, like bent pipe cleaner. Noto Sans Telugu sits beneath it with a high midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, a plain, sensible foil.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-thai: Tektur's strokes never thin or swell, and its curves leave generous gaps at their ends, so the headline feels drawn with one stiff wire. Plump, open letters follow.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tektur draws every stroke at the same gauge, with wide-open curve ends and oversized lowercase. And Noto Sans Thai Looped follows with tall bodies that look bold, leaving spacious gaps at its own terminals.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded and inviting, Noto Sans Tifinagh fills its lines with inflated bowls. Against Tektur, whose n arches are as thick as the stems beside them, the two make a striking pair: one rigid and wiry, the other soft and puffed.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Tektur looks like a sign-painter's single brush stroke held at constant width, with outsized lowercase. And Noto Sans Tirhuta takes over with a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave a big gap, so a longer passage would feel open and contemporary.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic reads friendly and tight, with very little gap between x-height and cap height. Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, so a longer stretch moves along easily beneath Tektur's rope-like stems.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai makes words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. Noto Sans Vai would carry a longer passage in a modern, approachable way, while Tektur's diagonals stay as heavy as its verticals.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Stiff, wiry and oversized, Tektur frames its counters with same-width strokes. And Noto Sans Vithkuqi, with open throats on a, c, e and s and a minimal step from capital to lowercase, supplies the quiet, modern counterweight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Tektur's diagonals are every bit as stout as its uprights, with curves opened wide at the terminals. But Noto Sans Wancho brings a hulking, chalk-pressed lowercase, so a longer passage would read dense, clean and contemporary.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Tektur feels like tracing a single thick thread. Noto Sans Warang Citi answers with words that form solid blocks and wide channels leading into each counter, the pair's strongest quality.
